description: This Java source file defines the implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface, providing methods for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, deleting items, and retrieving shopping cart data within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartFacade interface providing shopping cart management operations such as add, update, delete, and retrieve shopping cart data.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its ID and store.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by its code and store.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, creating the cart if necessary, and recalculates totals.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart model with a specified code, store, and customer.

methods.name: getEntryToUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific shopping cart item by its ID from the cart.

methods.name: getKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from the current request context by key.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data for a customer or by cart ID.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Populates and returns shopping cart data from a ShoppingCart model.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the cart and updates cart data.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item and recalculates totals.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Bulk updates multiple cart items, setting their quantities and recalculating totals.

methods.name: getCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart model by code and store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart model by customer and store.
